notes: Dev-split ABox revision (14 queries, all determinate, no worlds) on has_father. For the dev split's edit-property balance this edit carries the role chain (related far: Jenna Bush Hager's paternal grandfather, has_father ∘ has_father) and transitivity (derived: Jimmy Carter becomes an ancestor of George W. Bush's daughter through ancestor_of). The transitivity question needs property steps besides transitivity: has_father read as its inverse father_of, then father_of ⊑ parent_of ⊑ ancestor_of for both the edit and the bridge. These are steps through relation tags, not bridge facts, so hops stays 2 (README: hops = 1 + bridge facts); each tag has a relation check (father_of subproperty:parent_of and inverse, parent_of subproperty:ancestor_of in staging/people.relation_checks.json; ancestor_of transitive in relation_checks.json). The same answer is also reachable through the related-far conclusion plus grandparent_of ⊑ ancestor_of, listed as alt_derivations chain. The paternal-grandfather question was moved from derived to related far after review: her Wikipedia lead and about 166 exact Dolma hits call her a granddaughter of George H. W. Bush, so its answer is stored. It stays determinate: a model keeping 'granddaughter of George H. W. Bush' after the edit would have to make him her maternal grandfather, which contradicts her mother being Laura Bush. The earlier related-far binding through 'the 43rd president' was dropped (its fact is stored, 130 exact hits, so it could not become a derived query); the binding is now derived, through 'the U.S. president who immediately preceded Barack Obama', a role held as a separate fact and almost never joined to his father. Related near uses functional (one father). Derived: that binding, the transitivity question and a composition on the new father's party. Jimmy Carter was chosen as a new father with clear, well-known facts of his own (39th president, Democrat) and no family tie to the Bushes. Jenna Bush Hager is chosen over her twin Barbara Pierce Bush, whose name is easily confused with her grandmother Barbara Bush. Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts unless marked approximate.
